primary.method: Complete desktop captures in both themes and complete mobile captures displayed as consecutive native-width strips with 20-pixel overlap. All stems, options, visuals, explanations, per-choice rationales, learning cards and bottom controls were examined.

supplemental.capturedTheme: dark, after the driver exercised both themes
supplemental.method: Every captured plot/table right edge inspected after keyboard/scroll access checks. Five graphical items have two regions and three table-only items have one; 13 regions x 2 phases x 2 engines = 52 captures.

confirmedCorrections: Genuine eight-vertex/12-edge cube replaces the incomplete four-node display.
Cube text positions avoid edges; rendered edge/label collision testing added.
Residual excerpt versus full diagnostic identified; raw calls separated from illustrative residuals.
Equal-scale main-effect panels and explicit interaction cell means.
Exact numerical alternatives, explicit units, row/column headers and visible horizontal-scroll guidance.
captureLimits: A horizontally scrolled right-edge capture intentionally omits content to its left; it is not a whole-table image. Complete context was examined in primary views, and the driver verifies every cell and coordinate.
Mobile captures are browser emulation, not physical-phone screenshots.
Composite views are inspection aids; accepted artifact archives retain original PNG captures.
Actual interactions and geometry checks use the normal student interface, while element capture can suppress the sticky header without altering layout.
